name: spoke-kit
description: Claude intelligence layer for ESA Ecology design-system spokes. Ships the component-first discipline (skill + PreToolUse hook enforcing the Ecology esa-* -> Beacon -> bcn- lookup order), the accessibility discipline (skill + PreToolUse hook enforcing deterministic a11y practices — positive tabindex, missing alt, suppressed focus rings, keyboard-unreachable roles, permanently-empty live regions, role/aria-live politeness contradictions, interactive controls inside live regions, focus rings painted only with box-shadow and so deleted in forced colors mode — without prescribing patterns, plus the forms contract covering accessible names over placeholders, aria-describedby hints, live-region errors, fieldset/legend grouping, autocomplete/inputmode, and custom-listbox activedescendant, plus the status-message contract covering why a live region is the LAST resort, the cue/focus/state-property order that usually replaces one, the single shared announcer, and toasts under SC 2.2.1, plus the forced-colors contract covering what Windows Contrast Themes force-adjusts versus deletes outright, why ARIA is invisible to it, and the outline/transparent-border habits that prevent most of it), the hub-state discipline (SessionStart hook warning when the sibling ecology checkout has WIP that the spoke's file: symlinks are serving live, plus the /ship hub gate that blocks deploying it — escape ship-wip-approved:), the /spoke-init scaffolding command, and the spoke pre-commit review skill. Single source of truth lives in the ecology hub repo; do not copy these files into spokes.
